\section{\texttt{load\_feedback\_csv}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.ingestion.load_feedback_csv}\index{Functions!load\_feedback\_csv}

Load feedback records from a CSV file, validating the data contract first.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
load_feedback_csv(path: str | Path, *, strict: bool = True, telemetry: Telemetry | None = None) -> list[FeedbackRecord]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{path}] \texttt{str \textbar{} Path}, required. Path to a CSV file containing the required feedback columns.
  \item[\texttt{strict}] \texttt{bool}, default \texttt{True}, keyword-only. When True (default), any contract violation aborts ingestion. When False, invalid rows are skipped and the valid rows are returned.
  \item[\texttt{telemetry}] \texttt{Telemetry \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only. Optional telemetry emitter; emits \texttt{ingestion\_\allowbreak{}started} and \texttt{ingestion\_\allowbreak{}finished} events around the load.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{list[FeedbackRecord]\allowbreak{}}. Validated feedback records.
\apifield{Raises}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{FeedbackIngestionError}] In strict mode, if required columns are missing or any row violates the data contract.
  \item[\texttt{FileNotFoundError}] If the file does not exist.
\end{arglist}
